parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: How the sensor operates. Options are: ``{ poke | reschedule }``, default is ``poke``. When set to ``poke`` the sensor is taking up a worker slot for its whole execution time and sleeps between pokes. Use this mode if the expected runtime of the sensor is short or if a short poke interval is required. Note that the sensor will hold onto a worker slot and a pool slot for the duration of the sensor's runtime in this mode. When set to ``reschedule`` the sensor task frees the worker slot when the criteria is not yet met and it's rescheduled at a later time. Use this mode if the time before the criteria is met is expected to be quite long. The poke interval should be more than one minute to prevent too much load on the scheduler.
